perf.summary: The conditional store 'if (f[d] > f[j]) f[j] = f[d];' is a data-dependent branch; replace with a branchless max/min to avoid mispredicts and enable Burst vectorization.
perf.currentCost: Per inner step a compare + unpredictable conditional store. The j-stride loop (j += d) is strided but for small d it is dense; the branch is frequently 50/50 and mispredicts.
perf.proposedChange: RunMax: load long vj=f[j], vd=f[d]; f[j] = vd > vj ? vd : vj; (or math.max). RunMin symmetric with min. Hoisting vd=f[d] out of the inner loop (it is loop-invariant in j) also removes a redundant load per iteration.
perf.rationale: Branchless select removes mispredict penalty on a 50/50 branch and lets Burst emit conditional-move / vectorized max. Hoisting f[d] cuts one load per inner iteration (the value is invariant across the entire inner loop).
perf.risk: Branchless version always writes f[j] even when unchanged, adding a store where the original sometimes skipped it — for small-d dense passes this is usually a win, but for sparse large-d strides the extra store cost is negligible. Semantics identical (ties keep existing value either way). Caller must accept the unconditional write to f[j] (same memory, no aliasing change).

perf.summary: f[d] and cnt[d] are reloaded every inner iteration though invariant across the whole inner j-loop.
perf.currentCost: Each inner iteration reloads f[d] and cnt[d] for the compare/add; these never change inside the d-fixed inner loop.
perf.proposedChange: Hoist 'long fd = f[d]; int cd = cnt[d];' before the inner 'for (int j = 2*d; ...)' loop and use fd/cd in the body. Keep the three-way branch (>, ==) as-is since it has distinct side effects.
perf.rationale: Removes two redundant loads per inner iteration, shortening the per-step dependency chain. Cannot fully branchless this one due to the count-merge on equality, but invariant hoisting is a clean win.
perf.risk: None: f[d] and cnt[d] are not written inside the inner loop (writes target index j != d for j>=2d), so hoisting is safe. Observable behavior unchanged.
